limitations: No Lua query or callback was executed by this audit; expected results remain null for an independent original-source oracle.
Action cfg captures scalar fields and skillCond only, not every original structured cfg field; the proposed probe cfg is explicitly reconstructed, not asserted to be a traced original call.
Captured state is after MAIN calculation; replay does not validate source assembly, timing of condition writes, resource derivation, skill support applicability or complete native build admission.

All same-name records in each selected query dependency closure are retained with duplicate occurrences and layer/order. Unrelated names are not query dependencies and remain authenticated by full capture and layer hashes.
ModDB capture sorts distinct stat names, preserving within-name order; ModList capture preserves original row order. No across-name insertion order claim.
Actor fields are scalar-only; player/enemy links are source-proven by CalcSetup. More general actor links remain unresolved unless separately captured/proven.
Actor output is absent in dependencies.json; only player Life is bound from the paired exact snapshot. No missing GetStat value is silently replaced with zero.
Related retained numeric/LIST consumers are evidence only and may include unsupported mechanics. Selecting a FLAG query does not admit those consumers.
Corpus FLAG values contain no false/zero/negative/table/string cases; synthetic boundary tests are still necessary.
No native source parser, package capability ceiling, fixture dispatch or admitted build scope is changed.
